refused.message:
refusal[ESS-SYNTH-011]: entity gatepass.visit.Visit has no scenario `gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/admitted`
  `deposit.amount >= 0` cannot be read after this branch: no view of `gatepass.visit.Visit` holds an instance in `OnSite`
  help: declare a view that holds an instance in this state, or the invariant cannot be read after this branch

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-011]: entity gatepass.visit.Visit has no scenario `gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/admitted`
  `expected_minutes > 0` reads what no view of `gatepass.visit.Visit` publishes
    - `expected_minutes` is published by no view of the entity
  help: publish the fields the invariant reads in a view of this entity, or state the invariant over what one already publishes

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-011]: entity gatepass.visit.Visit has no scenario `gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/registered`
  `expected_minutes > 0` reads what no view of `gatepass.visit.Visit` publishes
    - `expected_minutes` is published by no view of the entity
  help: publish the fields the invariant reads in a view of this entity, or state the invariant over what one already publishes

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-011]: entity gatepass.visit.Visit has no scenario `gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/signed-out`
  `deposit.amount >= 0` cannot be read after this branch: no view of `gatepass.visit.Visit` holds an instance in `Departed`
  help: declare a view that holds an instance in this state, or the invariant cannot be read after this branch

refusal[ESS-SYNTH-011]: entity gatepass.visit.Visit has no scenario `gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/signed-out`
  `expected_minutes > 0` reads what no view of `gatepass.visit.Visit` publishes
    - `expected_minutes` is published by no view of the entity
  help: publish the fields the invariant reads in a view of this entity, or state the invariant over what one already publishes

gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/grant/denied.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` sent as `gatepass.visit.SecurityAuditor`, which the specification does not grant it, is refused before it runs

gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/outcome/admi.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` answers `admitted` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/outcome/wron.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` for an identity no record carries takes `wrong-state` and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Deposit/invariant/at/gate.purpose: every `gatepass.visit.Deposit` that `gatepass.visit.ExpectedVisits` publishes at `deposit` satisfies what the type declares

gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/grant/denie.purpose: `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` sent as `gatepass.visit.SecurityAuditor`, which the specification does not grant it, is refused before it runs

gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/outcome/ref.purpose: `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` answers `refused` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/outcome/reg.purpose: `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` answers `registered` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/grant/deni.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` sent as `gatepass.visit.SecurityAuditor`, which the specification does not grant it, is refused before it runs

gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/outcome/si.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` answers `signed-out` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/outcome/wr.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` for an identity no record carries takes `wrong-state` and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gat.purpose: a `gatepass.visit.Visit` still satisfies what it declares after `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` on `registered`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/Departed/refu.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Departed`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`
`gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Departed`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/Expected/refu.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Expected`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/OnSite/refuse.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `OnSite`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`
